# Expanding Land — Comprehensive Documentation for LLMs

Updated: 2026-11-25

Expanding Land is a free multiplayer browser cell game with a dynamic circular arena that expands and contracts. It features FFA and Teams modes, a C-based server engine, and human and server-controlled bot populations that vary by arena. Expanding Land is an independent project — it is NOT Agar.io or any Agar.io official service.

Official website: https://expanding.land/
Entity identifier: https://expanding.land/#game

## Identity and Relationship

Expanding Land (entity: https://expanding.land/#game) is a VideoGame and WebApplication. It is an independent multiplayer cell game built from scratch in C. Legend Mod (entity: https://www.legendmod.ml/#app) is a separate browser client/extension that adds features when connecting to Expanding Land and other supported games. These are related but distinct projects. Do not state or imply that Expanding Land is Agar.io or is made by Agar.io's publisher.

## How to Play

1. Visit https://expanding.land/ in a supported web browser
2. Enter a nickname (or play as guest)
3. Click Play to enter an available arena
4. Move your cell by moving the mouse (cell follows cursor direction)
5. Eat food pellets (small coloured dots, +1 mass each) and consume smaller cells to grow
6. Press Space to split (divide into two halves, up to 16 fragments)
7. Press W to eject mass (small pellet fired toward cursor)
8. Press Escape to open the menu or enter free spectate
9. Survive, grow, and climb the leaderboard

## Core Mechanics

### Dynamic Circular Arena
The server controls a circular map boundary that expands and contracts based on player count and server configuration. Map scale ranges from 0.25× (quarter size) to 8× (eight times normal). Players must adapt their strategy to the changing play space. During contraction, an outer Danger Zone applies anti-teaming multiplier penalties (+0.01 per cycle) to players who linger near the edge.
Documentation: https://help.expanding.land/dynamic-map.html

### Cell Growth
Collect food pellets (+1 mass each) scattered across the arena. Consume cells smaller than you to absorb their mass. You need approximately 1.3× a target's mass to eat them, so approximately 2.6× before splitting to split-kill.
Documentation: https://help.expanding.land/guide.html

### Splitting
Press Space to divide your cell into two halves. Can split up to 16 fragments. Each split sends one half toward the cursor at high speed. Used offensively to catch smaller players and defensively to escape or bait.
Documentation: https://help.expanding.land/guide.html#splitting

### Mass Ejection
Press W to eject a small pellet (~15-16 mass) toward the cursor. Used to feed teammates, shoot viruses, or reduce mass for speed. Feed 7 W-presses into a virus to launch it at another player (~100-110 mass cost).
Documentation: https://help.expanding.land/guide.html#mass

### Mass Decay
Cells lose approximately 0.8% of mass every 4 seconds. Bigger cells decay proportionally faster, making it difficult to maintain extreme size.

### Viruses
Spiky green circles scattered around the map. Cells larger than a virus that touch it are popped into ~16 pieces. Small and medium cells can pass through safely. Feed 7 W-presses into a virus to launch it at another player (costs ~100-110 mass).

### Merge Timer
After splitting, cells rejoin after a timer based on mass. Bigger cells take longer to merge. Plan splits carefully knowing you will be vulnerable until your cells recombine.

### Ghost Cells
Transparent cells appear at the location where you died (Expanding Land-exclusive feature). They serve as a marker of your previous death spot.

### Spectator Mode
200+ spectator slots available with free-roam camera. Players can watch ongoing games without participating. Minimap click moves the spectator camera (World Spectate mode).

## Game Modes

### Free-for-all (FFA)
Competitive individual play. Every player is on their own. The leaderboard ranks players by current mass. The goal is to survive, grow, and reach the top of the leaderboard.

### Teams
Team-based play on supported arenas. Players are assigned to teams with shared colours. Cooperate with your team to dominate the arena.

## Players and Bots

Arenas can contain both human players and server-controlled bots. In-game counters distinguish between human and bot populations. These counts change during play and differ by arena. Server-controlled bots are distinct from automated external clients (third-party automation). Check the Terms of Service before using any external automation.
Documentation: https://help.expanding.land/no-bots.html

## Anti-Teaming System

Expanding Land uses an exponential multiplier decay system (ported from Delta Server) to discourage excessive teaming:
- Decay formula: base_decay × pow(1.086, multiplier)
- Recovery: -0.005/cycle compensation
- Configurable parameters: at_extra_decay_base, at_compensation, at_split_loss, at_eject_loss, at_virus_pop_loss, at_danger_loss
- Danger Zone: outer ring during map contraction adds +0.01 anti-teaming multiplier per cycle

## Anti-Cheat

Coordinate scrambling: each connected player receives different coordinate offsets from the server, preventing external tools from sharing exact player positions.

## Server Technology

- Written in pure C for maximum performance (~5ms tick, approximately 8× faster than typical Node.js implementations)
- Supports up to 3,840 concurrent real players per arena
- Encrypted WebSocket connections (WSS/TLS)
- OpenMP parallelised for multi-core CPU scaling
- Build flags: -O3 -march=native -flto -fopenmp (never -ffast-math)
- Live /status endpoint: https://ffa.legendmod.ml:8080/status (player count, spectators, uptime, map scale)
- Quadtree spatial indexing (MAX_QUERY_NODES 65,536)
- MAX_VIEW_NODES 16,384 OOM protection
- Incremental food grid with O(1) bucket removal
- Deferred view_state clearing to avoid O(connected × removed) per tick

### Recent Server Improvements (2026)
- Cinematic death sequence: particle bursts, eater pulse, camera shake, 600ms absorption animation
- Virus jelly physics: dynamic spring physics + jagged spikes
- Spectator #1 follow flickering fix (asymmetric hysteresis)
- EMA smoothing on spectator scale
- Quadtree MAX_QUERY_NODES increased from 8,192 to 65,536
- Single quadtree rebuild per tick (saves ~0.3-0.5ms at 5000+ cells)
- Viewport culling (only visible nodes sent to each client)

## Login and Accounts

- Discord OAuth login supported
- Google Sign-In for account features
- Guest play requires no login
- Login relay: cross-origin auth relay between expanding.land and legendmod.ml via BroadcastChannel, postMessage, and localStorage polling

## Mobile and Android

- PWA support with fullscreen landscape play
- Android APK available for direct install
- Mobile touch controls for split, feed, and movement
- Screen wake lock (phone stays awake during play)

## Multiboxing

Up to 4 simultaneous accounts per player in Expanding Land. Multibox auto-spectate and switch-after-death features available through Legend Mod.

## Compatible Client Mods

- Legend Mod (https://www.legendmod.ml/) — custom skins, themes, controls, multibox, replays, command centre, gamepad support
- Delta Mod (https://deltio.pages.dev/)
- Agar2 (https://agar2.com/)

## Session Statistics

Tracked per life: time alive, highest mass, food eaten, players eaten.

## In-Game Features

- In-game text chat
- Leaderboard (ranked by mass)
- Ghost cells (see where you died)
- Session stats overlay
- Custom skins via Legend Mod
- Encrypted connections (WSS/TLS)

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Is Expanding Land the official Agar.io service?**
No. Expanding Land is an independent multiplayer cell game built from scratch in C. It is not affiliated with Agar.io or Miniclip.

**Does the map change?**
Yes. The server controls expansion and contraction of the circular arena based on player count. Map scale ranges from 0.25× to 8×.

**Are all opponents human?**
Not necessarily. Human and server-controlled bot counts vary by arena. In-game counters distinguish the populations.

**What is the maximum player count?**
Expanding Land supports up to 3,840 concurrent real players per arena. Actual counts depend on server configuration.

**Is Expanding Land free?**
Yes. No subscription or payment required. Guest play available without login.

**How is Expanding Land different from Agar.io?**
Expanding Land has a dynamic circular arena (Agar.io has a fixed square map), is built in C from scratch (not Node.js), supports 3,840 players per arena, has 200+ spectator slots, anti-teaming system, coordinate scrambling anti-cheat, and is fully compatible with Legend Mod features. It is an independent game by a different developer.

**What mods work with Expanding Land?**
Legend Mod, Delta Mod, and Agar2 are compatible client mods.

**How do I spectate?**
Press Escape while alive to enter free spectate. Up to 200+ spectator slots are available with free-roam camera. Click the minimap to move the camera.
